correctness.rationale: The exact proof identifies m negative adjacency eigenvalues by a unimodular matching minor. Every minimum cover C is a maximal face of D(F); the crosspolytope subcomplex from any maximum matching yields a primitive generator with coefficient ±1 at C. Negative-eigenspace restriction to C is invertible because V\C is independent and the adjacency form is negative definite. For each one-edge swap of covers, x^T A x=2x_b<0 supplies the same sign flip as the oriented cycle. Cover-flip connectivity follows from acyclic matching-contraction implication constraints. Equivariance gives equality of the integral ±1 characters. Standalone finite code checks 96 forests and 344 actions by exact Lefschetz and numerical spectral comparison.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies the full automorphism homology orientation character for an infinite natural family, rather than merely the known sphere rank. The determinant on negative adjacency eigenspaces is a conceptually distinct, canonical graph-spectral invariant, and the independent integer minimum-cover formula makes the character computable without spectral numerics. This topological–spectral bridge is not merely relabeling an existing Betti number and has meaningful use in equivariant topology of forest dominance complexes.
